title: a card the fitting check put up leaves once it no longer fits
line: an obituary's daughter, put by the fitting check to a woman of the tree with no family link yet, stays a card only while she fits: once the owner places that woman in her own family on the 1920 census, the decision compares the card with her again, closes it as superseded and matches the obituary again: the daughter, whom nobody in the tree fits now, is created by the rule as his daughter, and the granddaughter put to the same woman is a card as a new person

steps.say: his obituary, the file's own citation, naming his parents, brothers and sisters, children and grandchildren
its subject accepted by the owner: the daughter it names is put to Anna Rose Ahearn, who has no family link in the tree yet

rationale.has: Carol Miller (daughter) may be Anna Rose Ahearn

expect.why: the fitting check reaches a woman of the tree with no family link on the surname she is shown married under and the stated relationship alone

steps.say: the 1920 census page of her parents' household
her father accepted by the owner on the 1920 census
the rule takes her sister, the daughter the census states the father's

the owner accepts Anna R on the page as Anna Rose: the census states her the sister of a daughter the rule took, so she is placed in her parents' family, and the cards put to her are compared with her again

expect.why: the card the fitting check put up closes once she no longer fits: she has a family now, and the obituary's daughter stands in no relationship to it
the obituary matched again: the daughter it names, whom nobody in the tree fits now, created by the rule as it stands
the granddaughter proposed afresh as a new person, a card for the owner
